title: Do you work or are you sleeping?  Will it turn on if I walk this way, what about this way...
text: Do you work or are you sleeping?  Will it turn on if I walk this way, what about this way.... Not so easy to set up, the walk by function for turning on doesn't really work the way you want it to and i'm not even sure the stupid thing works anymore.  Having to stand in front of my clock madly waving to see if it works just isn't the reason I got a clock.  Save yourself the hassle.  It's just a black wooden box on my shelf now.

product_metadata.title: HITO153; Wood Grain LED Alarm Clock - Time Temperature Date - Display Sound Activated - Brightness Adjustable (black coating, Blue)
